entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: An extremely powerful elder moth demon who rules Duskmourn and feeds on fear.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane swallowed by the House, serving as Valgavoth's prison and feeding ground.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: A group of survivors devoted to serving Valgavoth in hopes he will cleanse the plane of fear.

entities.name: Marina Vendrell
entities.description: A girl who befriended the demon in her cellar and unwittingly loosened his shackles.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A resident of the House who made a deal with Valgavoth and betrays the Wanderer and Niko Aris.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A former planeswalker who enters Duskmourn to rescue Nashi.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker who enters Duskmourn with the Wanderer.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's son, who gathers a search party and enters the House to find her.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A former planeswalker whose echo Valgavoth draws from Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who impales Valgavoth and provides the team an escape via an artificial Omenpath.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A creature that can visualize the connections across all the planes of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Speed Demon
entities.description: A racer sent by Valgavoth to win the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: The Ascension
entities.description: Valgavoth's expansion of the House to encompass the entire plane.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Connections between planes that Valgavoth exploits to lure victims.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane to which Valgavoth opens a door to let Winter leave.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane where Valgavoth opened a door to draw in Tamiyo's echo.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane where the second Ghirapur Grand Prix was held, to which Valgavoth conjured a door.

events.summary: Centuries before the Omenpath Era, Valgavoth is summoned into the mortal realm by a previous owner of the House, who bind him beneath the basement after he proves too dangerous.
events.quote: The summoners managed to neutralize him by binding him to the structure of the house where they'd conducted the summoning

events.summary: Sixteen-year-old Marina Vendrell finds the demon in the cellar, and he befriends her to gain freedom.
events.quote: Seeing a path to his freedom, Valgavoth befriended her, helping her to learn demonology, necromancy, and spirit-bending.

events.summary: Marina lures her bullies into the basement and Valgavoth devours them; she realizes her friend is malevolent.
events.quote: She watched, horrified, as the hungry entity came alive and devoured the bullies.

events.summary: Empowered, Valgavoth hunts; the house expands and Marina's parents vanish.
Marina threatens to burn the house down and the demon agrees to restore the world as she remembered it, but the house keeps expanding until it swallows the plane.
events.quote: The demon grew in power until the entirety of the plane was swallowed up in the walls of Duskmourn.

events.summary: The Ascension: Valgavoth expands the House's boundaries to encompass the whole plane and gains a psychic connection to it.
events.quote: This event marked his successful expansion of the House's boundaries to encompass the entirety of the plane

events.summary: After ascending, Valgavoth kills most of the plane's other demons and breaks the rest.
events.quote: One of his first acts after ascending was killing most of the plane's other demons and breaking the rest

events.summary: Valgavoth opens a door on Kamigawa and draws in the echo of Tamiyo, prompting Nashi to lead a search party into the House.
events.quote: Valgavoth opened a door on Kamigawa and drew in the echo of the former planeswalker Tamiyo

events.summary: Winter leads the Wanderer and Niko Aris into the Cult's trap; Valgavoth manifests and opens a door to Innistrad for Winter.
events.quote: Eventually, Winter led the Wanderer and Niko Aris into a trap set by the Cult.

events.summary: Nashi destroys Tamiyo's echo, and Kaito Shizuki impales Valgavoth, letting the team escape via an artificial Omenpath.
events.quote: he was suddenly impaled by Kaito Shizuki

events.summary: Valgavoth, heavily wounded, has nonetheless captured Loot.
events.quote: Valgavoth had captured Loot , a creature that could visualize the connections across all the planes of the Multiverse.

events.summary: Valgavoth sends the Speed Demon and Winter to win the Ghirapur Grand Prix and gives Winter Loot.
events.quote: He sent the Speed Demon and Winter to win the race and bring the Aetherspark back to Duskmourn.

events.summary: After Winter loses the race and Loot, Valgavoth conjures a door from Avishkar to Duskmourn and drags him back.
events.quote: Valgavoth conjured a door connecting Avishkar to Duskmourn, dragging the man back through it.
